name: Toshiaki
source:
There are two types of humans in the world - nerds and and normal people. Of course main character Toshiaki is a nerd. His family holds a ryokan at a provincial town. But as long there is internet, he does not care at all. Somehow, he gets involved in a love affair. Can he pull it through?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
